status: Proposed hand-authored subset assertions; no runtime or public schema adoption
event_assumption: Each prefix is one fully reduced output event. Each listed continuation is a subsequent ordered event. Empty prefix is event cut 0.

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground
proposed_requirements_after: Row 1 columns 1-2 contain U+00E9 and X, one cell each; cursor is (1,3).
No replacement, reply or control is synthesized at the cut.

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground
proposed_requirements_after: Complete valid U+1F4A9, which is outside the dev repertoire, into exactly one width-one U+FFFD; then paint X.
Do not flush at the cut, retain a dependency iterator, or create emoji/grapheme/wide-cell state.

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground
proposed_requirements_after: Replace the prefix once with U+FFFD at (1,1), then process ESC as the query introducer.
Exactly one proposed CPR has hex 1b5b313b3252; replay dispatches none.

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground
proposed_requirements_after: A at (1,1) has foreground index 1; parser returns to ground.
The ESC at the prefix cut is retained, not printed or silently dropped.

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground

cases.cut_after: complete prefix event; parser need not be ground
